name: Hybrid (roles + topics + archive)
summary: Default for mixed personal corpora: a few role-bots at top level, topic/case folders for reference material, archive/ for finished work. Use when no single strategy covers the corpus.
when_to_use: The corpus mixes active work, reference piles, and finished projects.
The owner can't name a single organizing principle — most real corpora.
partitioning_rubric: Top level holds ONLY: role-bot folders (max 4), research/ (topics+cases), archive/, and shared scripts/data.
Classify every file by one question: is it ALIVE (someone will act on it again) or DEAD (finished, only for reference)? Alive goes to a bot or active project; dead goes to a topic folder or archive/.
Within research/, one folder per topic cluster; within archive/, one per finished effort, named by year-month if unknown.
The roster (root AGENTS.md) is mandatory in this strategy: one line per folder — name, kind, one-line role, state pointer.
When two folders both seem right, choose the one whose AGENTS.md scope statement the file would satisfy verbatim; if neither, add to unresolved.

folder_template.agents_md_skeleton:
# <Name>

## Kind
<bot|topic|case|project|archive>

## Role / scope
<one paragraph>

## Boundaries
- <what belongs elsewhere, and where>
